title: Test
content:
# Check network profile (should be Private, not Public)
Get-NetConnectionProfile

# If Public, change to Private:
Set-NetConnectionProfile -Name "Ethernet" -NetworkCategory Private
# (replace "Ethernet" with the Name shown above)

# Verify firewall rules are enabled
Get-NetFirewallRule -DisplayGroup "Remote Desktop" | Select-Object DisplayName, Enabled, Profile

# Force enable for all profiles
Enable-NetFirewallRule -DisplayGroup "Remote Desktop" -Profile Any

# Quick test from another device on LAN (or from this Mac):
# nc -zv 192.168.18.26 3389
